{{Top|leg}}
The '''RAPID weapon power regeneration technology''' was developed by [[Galactic Solutions Industries]] after a lengthy development [[Time/Legends|time]]. Magazine components utilizing the RAPID technology increased a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] weapon power regeneration rate by "recycling" extra heat generated by weapon stabilizers.
